article_title: Computational Thinking Boosters: Algorithmic Thinking in K-2
citation: Computational Thinking Boosters: Algorithms in K-2. (2021). Webinar presentation, NSF grant #1923314. https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=1923314
title: Recognize and name the algorithmic thinking already present in K-2 daily routines
description: The webinar asks teachers to consider "Where Am I Likely Already Integrating These Skills?" and notes that many K-2 skills are algorithmic in nature: following a daily schedule, collaboratively creating classroom procedures through testing and analyzing outcomes, and conversations about how sequence order affects outcomes. Teachers should surface these existing practices as computational thinking rather than adding wholly new content.
requirements: Teacher awareness of decomposition, pattern recognition, comparing and contrasting in existing routines
target_learning_goals: Recognizing algorithmic thinking in daily life
examples: Students and teachers collaborate to create classroom procedures through testing and analyzing outcomes
